governed.owner: Domain module owns namespace; GovernedRecordStore owns persistence
governed.transactions: Local private revision CAS with pending audit event in record; optional PG tenant-keyed row transaction/RLS, bounded transaction and no statement replay
governed.migration: Choose backend explicitly; validate existing canonical rows/revisions/outbox, preserve tenant encryption and uncertain execution; no automatic local-to-PG cutover claim
governed.recovery: Exact namespace policy from recovery_authorities; current bootstrap can authenticate selected records, retire supported work or block unknown authority
governed.limits: Shared record rows alone do not centralize local blobs, application locks, keys or cross-record workflows

sqlite_domain.owner: Named domain store owns its private SQLite file; composition chooses tenant path
sqlite_domain.transactions: Observed per-module SQLite transaction and schema code; module-specific CAS/idempotency/integrity remain authoritative; not a shared filesystem protocol
sqlite_domain.migration: Quiesce owning single control plane; consistent backup; validate schema/integrity and pending effects before explicit cutover; shared implementation required before HA
sqlite_domain.recovery: Known exact SQLite policies are applied; every otherwise unclassified SQLite blocks bootstrap globally, never silently resumes
sqlite_domain.limits: SQLite/file sidecars remain single-owned; individual SQL BEGIN/commit evidence is not distributed fencing qualification

configuration.owner: Explicit deployment/tenant identity, settings or credential module
configuration.transactions: Private files, module-specific locks/atomic replace and current authorization checks; listed mechanisms are observed, not assumed uniformly
configuration.migration: Retain exact tenant binding, revocation epochs and key custody; migrate through the owning API under stopped or fenced writers
configuration.recovery: Registry path policy governs credentials, replay/identity, instructions and config; unmapped auxiliary files need explicit disposition before migration
configuration.limits: No multi-host configuration/key authority is established by sharing a JSON directory

learning.owner: Optional learning, evaluation, promotion or research subsystem
learning.transactions: Local versioned artifacts, promotion/evaluation gates and locks where observed; some stores use world backend via learning_store
learning.migration: Preserve source/model/evaluator versions, held-out accounting and promotion approval; untrusted imported scores/instructions cannot become active authority
learning.recovery: Registry blocks instruction/decision state or discards specified derived learning logs before publication; custom paths require explicit mapping
learning.limits: Opt-in/research status does not make persistent execution-influencing state disposable

business_records.transactions: Canonical local records and their declared module lock/schema; audit/projection is not a replacement for canonical business history
business_records.migration: Quiesce owner, verify record identities/revisions and relationships, preserve source records; new shared adapter needed for HA
business_records.recovery: Apply registry when mapped; record a support disposition for unmapped custom business paths; never infer replay eligibility from backup presence
business_records.limits: These are durable customer records even where they do not directly authorize external work

preferences.transactions: Private bounded preferences; action-center records use governed revision CAS; other UI modules use their declared local replacement/lock
preferences.migration: Copy/validate preferences by principal or rebuild explicitly; they do not grant execution authority
preferences.recovery: Ordinary preference payloads may restore as data; restoring snooze/read/pin state cannot approve a source workflow
preferences.limits: Action-center preference storage is intentionally not an execution-authority namespace

derived.owner: Owning cache/index/projection subsystem; canonical source remains elsewhere
derived.transactions: Content/version-bound caches or rebuildable indexes; derive only from current canonical source; some caches affect retrieval and are protected conservatively
derived.migration: Invalidate/rebuild after canonical migration; preserve removal/tombstone and incomplete flags until source reconciliation; never promote stale index to truth
derived.recovery: Exact registry policy wins over this derived label (for example embedding/learned caches can block); unknown SQLite still blocks
derived.limits: Rebuildability does not establish authorization or exactly-once effects

audit.owner: Audit/evidence/receipt writer and signing custody owner
audit.transactions: Append/hash/signature/anchor and receipt-specific publication protocols; local index may be rebuildable while signed body/receipt is authority
audit.migration: Transfer chain, key identity, anchors, custody and retention together; verify coverage before cutover; no unsafely regenerated trust
audit.recovery: Use authenticated backup and signing/custody policy; preserve evidence gaps and unknown provider effects; opaque projection is not authoritative readback
audit.limits: Local locked append is not a qualified two-replica audit protocol

execution.owner: Owning queue, event, budget or external-effect coordinator
execution.transactions: Per-store claims/checkpoints/budgets and explicit effect state; local locks coordinate one host, not arbitrary replicas
execution.migration: Never reissue accepted or uncertain work; preserve identity, attempt receipts and current authority; transactional outbox/fencing required for shared migration
execution.recovery: Known jobs are terminalized/reconciled; forms/events/replay/budget state uses explicit registry; unknown SQLite blocks
execution.limits: Read-only diagnostics and lock files are support state, not permission to execute

recovery.transactions: Bounded authenticated archives, durable review/apply receipts and exact-state transactions; user workspace preimages remain bound to reviewed targets
recovery.migration: Only owning recovery protocol may publish or roll back; retain byte identity, keys, source-offline requirement and uncertain prior-effect state
recovery.recovery: Bootstrap and installation markers themselves control admission; clearing or copying a marker is not reconciliation
recovery.limits: The recovery protocol can block unsupported authorities; this is deliberate, not successful automatic HA migration

storage_primitive.owner: Caller owns authority; this module supplies mechanics
storage_primitive.transactions: Atomic filesystem primitives, paths, transaction resource ownership or shared operation helpers
storage_primitive.migration: Follow the calling store contract; a write helper itself owns no independent business namespace
storage_primitive.recovery: Classify the caller's exact destination and scope
storage_primitive.limits: A lock/connection helper is not another durable application authority

key_custody.owner: Deployment or tenant cryptographic custody owner
key_custody.transactions: Private atomic key creation/rotation; tenant and purpose-bound envelope encryption
key_custody.migration: Authenticate retained key material, rotation lineage and tenant binding; loss or wrong scope must stop decryption/admission
key_custody.recovery: Retained-key validation or explicit discard/rotation policy; never reconstruct missing authority from ciphertext metadata
key_custody.limits: Shared database alone does not share or recover cryptographic authority

read_projection.owner: Owning authority elsewhere; module reads/composes a view
read_projection.transactions: Path resolution/read operations, or delegated store API; no independent durable write established by the source seam
read_projection.limits: data_dir or connect alone is not a write authority

composition.owner: Named domain store owns persistence; dashboard/runtime binds tenant and path
composition.transactions: Construction/delegation to existing authority; inline SQLite/key writers are separately labeled
composition.migration: Preserve exact tenant routing and current credential references; migrate the store, then rebind composition
composition.limits: Composition modules are entry points, not duplicate databases

artifact.owner: Requested output, evidence exporter or development/release tooling
artifact.transactions: Explicit output file/artifact creation; immutable evidence sources remain elsewhere
artifact.migration: Move/export artifact only; do not import as runtime authority without separate admission
artifact.recovery: User artifacts are data; recovery-relevant signatures/source authorities follow owning contract
artifact.limits: Tooling baselines, generated docs and export files are not control-plane claims

transient.owner: Owned temporary job, parser, transport or preparation lifecycle
transient.transactions: Private bounded job staging and owned process lifecycle; publish verified results through final owner
transient.migration: Do not migrate in-flight scratch as completed work; discard/retry preparation under current authority
transient.recovery: Temporary bytes do not authorize execution; journaled admission and final output authority remain separate
transient.limits: Not a persistent business authority merely because write_bytes is called

external.owner: User workspace, external DB/service or in-memory analytical engine
external.transactions: Existing tool/driver permission and transaction boundary; external data owner controls durability
external.migration: Customer data movement is explicit; no control-plane migration inferred
external.recovery: Local backup does not restore external service state; reconcile effects at provider
external.limits: A socket connect, read-only driver or user file edit is not a new Lightwork store

draft.transactions: Encrypted owner/context-bound payload and retention/preview receipt; applying draft still needs current live authority
draft.migration: Retire or recover draft under owner; never mutate live resources merely by restoring the draft
draft.recovery: Draft retention markers use registry; import staging is not a completed restore
draft.limits: A recoverable draft is durable user data but not approval

world.owner: WorldModel backend owns goals, messages, claims, approvals, facts and attachment submissions
world.transactions: SQLite transaction or PG tenant transaction/RLS; versioned migrations and exact claim/approval identity
world.migration: Use supported schema ladder and least-privilege tenant migration; snapshot canonical rows with owner stopped/fenced
world.recovery: world.db bootstrap invalidates approvals/reconciles active work while preserving attempt receipts; PG backup needs its database protocol
world.limits: World PG does not cover all other local authorities

a2a.owner: A2A store/runtime owner and explicit offline maintenance CLI
a2a.transactions: Local SQLite legacy or explicit governed shared backend; namespace transaction joins claims, indexes and quotas. Encrypted tasks.authority.sealed binds tenant/shared generation under the local admission lock and prevents downgrade
a2a.migration: Explicit a2a migrate-claims requires one stopped tenant, exclusive root/binding locks, readable original keys and bounded source. SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE binds logical and raw source digests; 20-row PG checkpoints preserve terminal, unknown and tombstone claims. Ready totals precede exclusive verified archive publication and source unlink; retries verify the retained receipt. No automatic cutover
a2a.recovery: Restored claim and tasks.authority.sealed binding authority blocks startup pending current shared-authority reconciliation; never automatically rerun uncertain tasks
a2a.limits: Singleton remains required. Native local migration/crash/race evidence does not qualify whole-control-plane HA or network partitions

knowledge.owner: Knowledge corpus store or vector adapter; canonical source/content identity owns truth
knowledge.transactions: Configured SQLite/PG/vector-native backend with explicit tenant/collection scope; vector recall replacement is versioned and bounded
knowledge.migration: Preserve source documents/provenance; rebuild index after source migration; adapter-specific atomic replacement qualification required
knowledge.recovery: knowledge.db passive-data validation differs from governed rights/approval state; unknown custom SQLite remains blocked
knowledge.limits: Native vector support does not establish global control-plane HA

test_only.transactions: Disposable fixture state; no product authority
test_only.limits: Included only to explain scanner false positives

mixed_api.owner: CLI/API delegates to named owners and also publishes artifacts/configuration
mixed_api.transactions: Inspect listed write functions: artifact output vs HALT/config/key publication; storage owner remains originating domain
mixed_api.migration: Migration follows target owner; generated walkthrough/export files are output only
mixed_api.recovery: Current registry applies to HALT/config/state targets; export data does not authorize replay
mixed_api.limits: One file can have more than one semantic role

derived_analytics.recovery: Preserve derived analytics as data; fresh complete source reads and current permissions decide visibility and execution eligibility; restored assumptions cannot authorize source work
